question: Does LLM7 apply the free-token limits (1 request per second, 60 per minute, 250 per hour, 100,000 tokens per 24 hours) to keyless calls, or a lower anonymous tier? The first-party limits table lists no anonymous row.
why: keyless completions still answer 200 and return no rate-limit header, so the keyless ceiling cannot be read from a response without provoking a 429
